messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Multiple prod deploy pipelines failing at 'authenticate to GitHub Actions / packages' step. Affected: `deploys/inference-api`, `deploys/router`, `deploys/ingest`. See https://www.githubstatus.com/ (reported incident). Paging Lydia (oncall). :rotating_light:
Lydia (oncall): Oncall ack. What's the error in the logs?
Noah (eng): Example from workflow run 7991:
```
Run actions/checkout@v3
  with:
    token: ***
##[error]Request failed with status code 401
Error: Unable to authenticate when fetching package @redwood/models from npm.pkg.github.com
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/@redwood/models - You can only access this resource using the GitHub Actions token or a PAT with appropriate scopes.
```
Aisha (SRE): deploy-bot: how many affected runs?
deploy-bot: 21 runs failed in the last 10m across main and hotfix branches; 12 are prod-critical.
Kat (infra): Confirming GH status shows: "Problems with Actions authentication and Packages" -> https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/def456 (updated 3m ago). They list "token authorization errors".
Lydia (oncall): Customer impact assessment: currently no increase in 5xxs from inference endpoints. Hotfix pipeline for token routing is blocked — cannot ship. I'll promote incident to P0 for CI-blocking.
Noah (eng): Quick mitigation options brainstorm:
- Use prebuilt container image from our internal registry (we have nightly images for canaries) and promote to prod manually.
- Use our mirrored npm tarballs in GCS (we mirror only core packages weekly, may miss the new patch package).
- Attempt to run a local build on our VM hosts and rsync artifacts to nodes (manual, risky).
- Try to trigger deployments from Runner-less approach (self-hosted runners still auth through GH; if Actions auth is down, can't request ephemeral tokens).
Aisha (SRE): Self-hosted runners generate their own runner tokens from GH; if GH token service is failing, won't help. That rules out creating new runner jobs.
Kat (infra): I can promote the latest canary image `registry.redwood.internal/inference:canary-1975` to `prod` tag. That contains yesterday's binaries; it won't have today's patch but will roll back recent canary changes — safer than waiting.
Noah (eng): Could we build the hotfix inside a container locally and push directly to our registry bypassing GH Actions? Yes — I can build on my laptop and push if we have creds. But pushing to registry requires our CI bot account token which is stored in GitHub secrets (pulls from GH) — do we have an alternate service account?
Lydia (oncall): Kat, proceed with image promotion if it reduces risk. Noah, start a local build as fallback and upload to `registry.redwood.internal/tmp` using your dev creds. Tag must include `promoted-by:oncall` in metadata for audit.
Noah (eng): Starting local build now. Commands:
```
docker build -t registry.redwood.internal/inference:hotfix-1975001 .
docker push registry.redwood.internal/inference:hotfix-1975001
```
(Will paste push logs in thread.)
Aisha (SRE): Notifying PMs & CS: "CI pipelines are currently blocked by GitHub Actions auth issue; we are promoting a previously built image as a fallback to avoid having production regressions. No customer-facing errors observed yet."
deploy-bot: Promotion job triggered for `inference-api` -> promoting tag `canary-1975` to `prod`. Job id: 50233.
Noah (eng): push complete from my workstation. Pushed `hotfix-1975001` -> `registry.redwood.internal`. Pushed by user `noah-eng`.
Logs:
```
The push refers to repository [registry.redwood.internal/inference]
Digest: sha256:abcd...
Status: Uploaded
```
Kat (infra): Verified image signature and checksum. Starting canary swap.
Lydia (oncall): Running smoke checks now. If smoke passes, we'll cut traffic over.
Aisha (SRE): Smoke OK on canary (latency within baseline). No errors in logs.
Lydia (oncall): Cutting prod traffic to promoted image. Watch for errors for 15m.
GitHub Support Bot: Support Ticket created: #GH-91234. GitHub status page indicates "Investigating" for Actions auth.
Lydia (oncall): Handoff plan: I'm going to escalate to GitHub and stay up. If this is not resolved in 30m, Tom (oncall-night) will take over at shift change. Tom, please be ready to continue bridge.
Tom (oncall-night): I see. I'll take over at 22:00 UTC and keep monitor until resolution. DM me the ticket link.
Noah (eng): One caveat: promoting the canary image removes the hotfix. We need to reapply the token routing patch after GH is healthy. I'll prepare a patch PR but won't merge until CI is back.
Aisha (SRE): Post-incident actions noted: 1) Add fallback publish path that doesn't require GH secrets for emergency pushes 2) Expand our package mirror cadence from weekly->daily for core packages 3) Document manual promote runbook and audit steps.
Lydia (oncall): Good notes. Closing initial remediation step: canary promoted -> prod replaced. Incident severity remains P0 until GH resolves or until we validate merge path.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Prod reverted to promoted image. 0 errors in initial 10m.
Lydia (oncall): Updating incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/internal/incidents/1975001111. Will attach logs and checklist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
